page.overview:
What is Larvik?

Larvik is one of the three villages located on the island of Hindarsfjall. One of the older settlements in the Skellige Isles, it is the home base of Clan Heymaey.

Every week before Belleteyn, Freya's priestesses visit the village. Those in poor health, troubled by bad dreams, pregnant mothers, and women with sick children come to the jarl house, where, for a small fee, the goddess's servants will help anyone in need.

Every year, there's a horse race that starts from the west gate of the city and goes to Freya’s Garden in honor of Freya, organized by the priestesses. In 1271, the winner was Astrid the Vipress, renowned as the fastest horse rider in the isles.

Larvik is led by its current jarl, Donar an Hindar. A tavern, an armorer, a blacksmith, and a merchant can be found there.
